pros: Seamlessly integrates two-factor authentication (TOTP) with stored logins.
Provides a secure and convenient way to manage various types of credentials and secure notes.
Autofill and browser extension simplify routine logins and password generation.
cons: Occasional clunkiness or slow loading of the browser extension.
Initial setup for shared credentials or advanced features may have a slight learning curve.
May occasionally require re-logging in more frequently than desired.
changed: Pro 2: The note '[benefit] The Add button offers Login, Card, Identity, Note, SSH key and Folder in one dropdown, so starting a CRM login or a server-access note took two clicks.' provided a more specific and broader scope of 'credentials' than just 'client credentials', justifying the change to 'various types of credentials and secure notes'.
